annotations.title: Get a Federal Award by PIID

description: One federal award in the "Bought by the government" lane of Who Gets Your Data, a MORVS pilot register built from USAspending prime contract transactions (award types A to D) by action-date fiscal year over the lane's window (FY2017 to FY2026 at launch), found by its PIID (6 to 40 letters, digits or hyphens, case ignored) through the register's lookup file. Returns each transaction with its date, fiscal year, amount obligated, label (a capability, a bundle, or a label that is never counted), basis, the matched words and the words as published or "withheld"; the award's review (label, verified words and note); its net obligations by fiscal year; and the outlay for the whole award where the award record gives it. It says whether the award is counted in the lane, awaiting review (never counted until reviewed), not counted (words mixed with another product), unclassified or in the separate benefits and identity panel. A PIID can name more than one award; each is returned. Amounts are obligations net of de-obligations, never outlays: an outlay appears only where the award record gives one, labelled as the outlay for the whole award. A contract is not proof of use on any person. Capability comes from the award's own words or a single-product vendor's product line, each with its basis (transaction_words, award_base_words, vendor_product or review); a bundle naming two capabilities sits in the lane total and in no capability total. The floor year (FY2026 at launch) is a floor, as Defense Department actions reach FPDS late, and each figure for it is flagged. A reviewed universe, not a complete inventory. An empty result returns the lane's absence note: no award in this reviewed universe, which says nothing about purchases outside it. The lane is a separate table: never added to the benefits and identity panel, the context (Palantir, Dataminr Defense Department licences), the excluded amounts or the handoff, broker and legal-duty tables. The answer carries as_of, the file dates, the source page on morvs.ai, the licence and the lane's universe, obligation, use, capability, floor, absence, context and panel notes. Recipients as filed, organisations only: the register drops sole proprietors and person-shaped recipients, and award words that could name a person are published as "withheld".

piid.description: Required award PIID, 6 to 40 letters, digits or hyphens (case ignored), for example 70CMSD25P00000111.
